1.note: native prairie both sides: left beyond the cart path, right from ~15 yds off the fairway to the service road

2.note: right between fairway and path is mown rough (green mowing stripes in 2022, only drought-tan in 2023); native beyond the path and left above the pond

3.note: native left from the cart path out; narrow native strip right in front of the tree line/OB; auto trees and OB along the industrial yard look right

5.note: classic native bands: left band ~-55..-36 full length, right from ~6 yds off the fairway across the path

6.note: native right (inside and past the path, incl. hayed native at +45..+70 along 280-380); left in front of the trees near the tee

8.note: dogleg left: native band right between fairway and woods, and across the end of the fairway in front of the woods (lidar 0.5-2.5 m speckle)

9.note: native mounds left (to the pond/creek), across the gap between the two fairways at ~300-330, and right in front of the trees; pond left a bit bigger than auto

10.note: native beyond the right path, left of the green beyond the path crossing, and a patch far left by the pond; creek / pond auto ok

11.note: native ridge left between 11 and the next fairway (5 yds of rough); right native from ~15 yds (near tee) / ~7 yds (further) off the fairway out past the path

13.note: native right between fairway and path and beyond; left between fairway and the path/ditch; auto 'water' band follows the cart path + ditch (left unchanged, see uncertain)

15.note: wide native band left (~12 yds of rough then native to ~-57); right native past the path

16.note: native both sides ~5-6 yds off the fairway, incl. the island in the right fairway notch at 270-300; right-side tree near the green bigger than auto

18.note: native left band between path and fairway near the tee (x -30..-13), thin left strip further on; right strip between fairway and woods (brown in 2022 too)

uncertain.what: auto water band along the left cart path and the diagonal path (along 120-400) is mostly path + a narrow ditch (DEM channel); real water width likely 2-4 yds; left unchanged
